proposal.title: Quamibkal: an end-to-end encrypted backup client
proposal.summary: Quamibkal builds an end-to-end encrypted backup client for small organisations and households.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.text: We will build an end-to-end encrypted backup client called Quamibkal. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Each component gets tests and a fuzz target before it is merged.

sections.heading: Relevance to the Open Internet Stack
sections.text: Encrypted backups is part of the Open Internet Stack. An open implementation lets anyone inspect, reuse and improve it without asking a vendor for permission.

sections.heading: Team and experience
sections.text: We maintain http://forge.test/quamibkal/quamibkal, which 296 public projects depend on. Our team has worked on encrypted backups for 9 years.

sections.heading: Deliverables and licence
sections.text: All code will be released under the Apache-2.0 licence in http://forge.test/quamibkal/quamibkal. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

sections.heading: Milestones
sections.text: The work runs over 8 months in 3 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 2. Core implementation ends in month 5. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 8.

sections.heading: Budget justification
sections.text: The plan asks for 34200.00 EUR for 56 days of work over 3 tasks. Day rates range from 550.00 EUR to 700.00 EUR.

proposal.narrative:
Approach
We will build an end-to-end encrypted backup client called Quamibkal. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Each component gets tests and a fuzz target before it is merged.

Relevance to the Open Internet Stack
Encrypted backups is part of the Open Internet Stack. An open implementation lets anyone inspect, reuse and improve it without asking a vendor for permission.

Team and experience
We maintain http://forge.test/quamibkal/quamibkal, which 296 public projects depend on. Our team has worked on encrypted backups for 9 years.

Deliverables and licence
All code will be released under the Apache-2.0 licence in http://forge.test/quamibkal/quamibkal. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

Milestones
The work runs over 8 months in 3 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 2. Core implementation ends in month 5. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 8.

Budget justification
The plan asks for 34200.00 EUR for 56 days of work over 3 tasks. Day rates range from 550.00 EUR to 700.00 EUR.
